Categories.Label: Cities powered (final round)
Categories.Description: Primary win condition: most cities powered in the final Bureaucracy phase. Game ends when first player reaches 17 cities built.

Categories.Label: Elektro (tiebreaker 1)
Categories.Description: Most Elektro remaining wins ties on cities powered.

Categories.Label: Plants total capacity (tiebreaker 2)
Categories.Description: If still tied, sum of city capacity across owned plants (cosmetic).

Phases: 2. Power Plant Auction (1-2 plants per turn)
5. Bureaucracy (power cities + income + restock + step transition)

Reasoning: Curated 2026-05-31 from Power Grid base game (2-6 players, ~120 min). NO dice (deterministic auction + market). Heavy euro: 5 distinct phases per round, leader plays LAST in auction/resource phases (REVERSE turn order based on cities powered, this is the critical mechanic). 4 resource types with dynamic market scarcity (coal/oil/garbage/uranium). Elektro currency, plants storage max 3, network building on country map. 3 game Steps (1/2/3) triggered by city count, each expanding board area + plant market + adding constraints. End-game: first player builds 17th city → final Bureaucracy round, then most cities powered wins (Elektro tiebreaker).

ExcludedTools.Reason: Power Grid is deterministic auction + market, no dice involved.
Power plant market is a face-up grid (Current Market + Future Market), not a shuffled deck. Special handling required.
